verdict.rationale: Solid's README explicitly lists "Universal: write custom renderers to use Solid anywhere," which directly matches the story of targeting platforms beyond the browser DOM. The support rests on a single one-line feature bullet, with no further detail in the pack. Missing for 10: documentation of the custom renderer API and how to implement one, examples of shipped non-DOM renderers, and independent or hands-on corroboration that custom renderers work in practice.
